entities.name: Cathedral of the Consolata (Tehran)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Consolata, also called the Roman Catholic Cathedral of Tehran, is a Catholic Church building in the city of Tehran, Iran, in which the Latin or Roman rite is followed. The shrine is dedicated to Blessed Virgin Mary under her title of Our Lady of Consolation.
